zh: 开完会我打给你。
en: I'll give you a ring after the meeting.
alt: I'll call you once the meeting's finished.
point: “开完会”说 after the meeting 就行，不用 finish the meeting

zh: 等你有空再说吧。
en: Let's talk about it when you're free.
alt: We can chat when you've got a minute.
point: “等…再…”用 when 从句，不说 wait you free

zh: 要是卡住了就重启一下。
en: If it freezes, just restart it.
alt: Just reboot it if it hangs.
point: 中文“就”不翻；if 从句用现在时，主句用祈使句

zh: 保存了再关。
en: Save it before you close it.
alt: Make sure you save it before closing it.
point: “…了再…”表示先后，用 before，不是 then again

zh: 等菜上齐了再吃吧。
en: Let's wait until all the food comes out.
alt: Let's wait till everything's here before we start.
point: “等…再”用 wait until，until 后用现在时

zh: 吃完了叫服务员买单。
en: When we're done, let's ask for the bill.
alt: Let's get the bill once we've finished.
point: “吃完了”用 when we're done；买单是 the bill，不是 buy the menu

zh: 下雨的话比赛就取消。
en: If it rains, the game's off.
alt: The match will be cancelled if it rains.
point: “下雨的话”是 if it rains，不说 if it will rain

zh: 一听到哨声就开始跑。
en: Start running as soon as you hear the whistle.
point: “一…就…”用 as soon as，不是 one hear then run

zh: 你路过超市帮我买点牛奶。
en: If you're passing Countdown, can you grab some milk?
alt: Can you get milk when you go past the shops?
point: “路过”用 if you're passing / when you go past

zh: 不合适可以退。
en: You can return it if it doesn't fit.
alt: If it doesn't fit, you can bring it back.
point: 中文省掉“如果”，英文一定要补上 if

zh: 到了给我发个信息。
en: Text me when you get there.
alt: Flick me a message once you arrive.
point: “到了”指将来，用 when you get there，不用 arrived

zh: 过安检之前把水喝完。
en: Finish your water before you go through security.
point: “之前”在英文里放后面：before + 从句；过安检 go through security

zh: 不舒服就请假。
en: If you're not feeling well, take the day off.
alt: Take a sick day if you're feeling crook.
point: “不舒服”是 not feeling well；“就”不翻，用 if

zh: 饭后吃这个药。
en: Take this after you eat.
alt: Take these after meals.
point: “饭后”是 after you eat / after meals，不说 after rice

zh: 出门前关灯。
en: Turn the lights off before you leave.
alt: Switch the lights off before you head out.
point: “出门”是 leave / head out，不是 go out the door

zh: 我到家就给你回电话。
en: I'll call you back as soon as I get home.
point: “就”用 as soon as，从句用现在时 get，不说 will get

zh: 你来了我们就开始。
en: We'll start once you're here.
alt: We'll kick off as soon as you arrive.
point: “你来了”是将来，用 once you're here，不用 came

zh: 周末不忙就过来吃烧烤吧。
en: Come over for a BBQ this weekend if you're not busy.
alt: If you're free this weekend, come round for a barbie.
point: “不忙就…”用 if you're not busy，放句尾很自然

zh: 钱到账了告诉我。
en: Let me know when the money comes through.
alt: Tell me once the money's gone in.
point: “到账”是 come through / go in，不说 arrive account

zh: 不够的话我借你。
en: If you're short, I can lend you some.
point: “不够”是 if you're short；借给你用 lend，不是 borrow

zh: 等 Aroha 休假回来，我们再定这件事。
en: We'll make a call on that when Aroha's back from leave.
alt: Let's decide once Aroha gets back from leave.
point: when 后用现在时 's back，不说 will be back；“定”是 make a call

zh: 这份报告你看完以后转给财务部。
en: Once you've been through the report, forward it on to Finance.
alt: After you've read the report, can you send it to Finance?
point: “看完以后”用 once + 现在完成时 you've been through

zh: 部署前先备份一下数据库，以防万一。
en: Back up the database before we deploy, just in case.
alt: Let's take a backup of the database before deploying, just in case.
point: “以防万一”是 just in case，放在句尾

zh: 直到我清了缓存，页面才正常显示。
en: The page didn't load properly until I cleared the cache.
alt: It wasn't until I cleared the cache that the page loaded properly.
point: “直到…才…”要用 didn't … until，主句用否定

zh: 你要是不吃辣，可以叫他们少放点辣椒。
en: If you can't handle spicy food, ask them to go easy on the chilli.
point: “不吃辣”是 can't handle spicy；“少放”是 go easy on

zh: 我们一坐下，服务员就把水端上来了。
en: As soon as we sat down, the waiter brought us some water.
alt: The moment we sat down, the waiter brought over some water.
point: 过去的“一…就…”也用 as soon as，两边都用过去时

zh: 我一般等孩子睡了才去跑步。
en: I usually wait until the kids are asleep before I go for a run.
alt: I don't usually go for my run until the kids are in bed.
point: “等…了才…”是 wait until … before，不说 wait kids sleep

zh: 全黑队今晚要是赢了，就进决赛了。
en: If the All Blacks win tonight, they'll be in the final.
alt: The All Blacks will make the final if they win tonight.
point: if 从句用现在时 win，will 只放在主句

zh: 这个降价了你通知我一声好吗？
en: Can you let me know if it goes on sale?
alt: Could you tell me when it's on special?
point: “降价”是 go on sale / on special；if 后用现在时

zh: 等黑五再买吧，到时候肯定更便宜。
en: I'd wait until Black Friday — it'll definitely be cheaper then.
alt: Wait till Black Friday to buy it — it's bound to be cheaper.
point: “等…再买”是 wait until，“到时候”是 then

zh: 我们得在天黑前赶到陶波。
en: We need to get to Taupō before it gets dark.
alt: We've got to make it to Taupō before dark.
point: “天黑前”是 before it gets dark，dark 前要有 it gets

zh: 万一航班延误了，我们就在机场附近住一晚。
en: If the flight's delayed, we'll just stay the night near the airport.
point: “万一…就…”这里用 if，if 后不用 will

zh: 我包里总带着创可贴，以防孩子摔倒。
en: I always keep plasters in my bag in case the kids fall over.
alt: I always carry plasters in case the kids hurt themselves.
point: “以防”是 in case，后面用现在时；创可贴叫 plaster

zh: 打完疫苗以后在这儿坐十五分钟再走。
en: After your jab, please wait here for fifteen minutes before you leave.
alt: Please stay for fifteen minutes after your vaccination before heading off.
point: “打完疫苗以后”是 after your jab；“再走”用 before you leave

zh: 我做饭的时候你能帮我看一下孩子吗？
en: Can you keep an eye on the kids while I'm cooking?
alt: Could you watch the kids while I make dinner?
point: 正在做的“…的时候”用 while + 进行时；看孩子 keep an eye on

zh: 房东说下周修理工来了再修热水器。
en: The landlord says the hot water cylinder will get fixed when the plumber comes next week.
point: 说的是下周，when 后仍用现在时 comes

zh: 你到奥克兰的话一定要告诉我，我请你喝咖啡。
en: If you're ever in Auckland, let me know and I'll shout you a coffee.
point: “到…的话”是 if you're ever in；“我请你”Kiwi 说 shout

zh: 聚会完了你要是没车，我开车送你回去。
en: I can drop you home after the party if you need a lift.
alt: If you need a ride after the party, I'll take you home.
point: “送你回去”是 drop you home / give you a lift

zh: 工资一到账我就把房租转给你。
en: I'll transfer the rent as soon as I get paid.
alt: I'll send you the rent money once my pay comes in.
point: “工资到账”直接说 get paid；as soon as 后用现在时

zh: 除非利率降下来，不然我们暂时不买房。
en: We're not buying a house unless interest rates come down.
alt: We won't buy a place unless the rates drop.
point: “除非…不然”只要 unless，不要再加 otherwise

zh: 等我们拿到客户的反馈之后，再决定要不要推进第二阶段。
en: Once we've heard back from the client, we can decide whether to go ahead with phase two.
alt: We'll make a decision on phase two once we've got the client's feedback in hand.
point: “拿到反馈”是 hear back from；“要不要”用 whether to

zh: 你要是周五前搞不定，提前跟我说一声，我好找人帮你。
en: If you can't get it done by Friday, give me a heads-up so I can find someone to help.
point: “提前说一声”是 give me a heads-up；“周五前完成”用 by Friday

zh: 补丁上线之前我们先别动生产环境，免得把事情搞得更糟。
en: Let's leave production alone until the patch goes out, so we don't end up making things worse.
alt: We shouldn't touch production before the patch is released, or we might make things worse.
point: “之前先别”用 not … until / leave … alone until

zh: 万一迁移出问题，我们得有个回滚方案，所以周末之前一定要测好。
en: We need a rollback plan in case the migration goes wrong, so it has to be tested before the weekend.
point: 预防性的“万一”用 in case，后面用现在时 goes wrong

zh: 如果周六晚上要订十个人的位子，最好提前一周打电话，不然肯定订不到。
en: If you want a table for ten on a Saturday night, you'd better ring a week ahead or they'll be fully booked.
point: “最好”是 you'd better；“不然”用 or，不说 if not

zh: 等主菜上来的时候我们估计已经饱了，所以前菜少点一点。
en: By the time the mains come out, we'll probably be full, so let's not order too many starters.
point: “等…的时候已经…”用 by the time，从句现在时，主句将来

zh: 只要大家每周坚持来训练两次，等赛季开始的时候我们肯定没问题。
en: As long as everyone keeps turning up to training twice a week, we'll be fine by the time the season starts.
point: “只要”是 as long as，不是 only need；从句用现在时

zh: 膝盖完全好之前教练不让我上场，估计还得再坐一个月板凳。
en: The coach won't let me play until my knee's fully recovered, which probably means another month on the sidelines.
point: “…之前不让”用 won't … until；坐板凳是 on the sidelines

zh: 网上下单满一百块包邮，而且下午两点前下单的当天就能发货。
en: If you order online, shipping's free over a hundred bucks, and anything ordered before 2 pm goes out the same day.
point: “满…包邮”是 free shipping over…；“发货”说 goes out

zh: 这台冰箱你先别急着买，等年中大促再看看，能省不少钱。
en: I'd hold off on that fridge until the mid-year sales — you could save a fair bit.
alt: Don't rush into buying that fridge; wait for the mid-year sales and you'll save heaps.
point: “先别急着买”是 hold off on；“等…再”用 until

zh: 你们到了皇后镇以后先去取车，等我们晚上到了再一起吃饭。
en: Once you land in Queenstown, go and pick up the rental car, and we'll all have dinner together when we get in tonight.
point: 两个“到了”都是将来，用 once / when + 现在时

zh: 出发之前记得查一下路况，要是沙漠公路因为下雪封了，我们就绕道走。
en: Check the road conditions before we leave — if the Desert Road's closed because of snow, we'll take the long way round.
point: “封路”是 closed；“绕道”是 take the long way round

zh: 等你复查结果出来以后，我们再讨论要不要做手术。
en: Once your follow-up results come back, we'll talk about whether surgery's the right option.
point: “结果出来”是 results come back；“要不要”用 whether

zh: 症状要是比较轻的话，先打健康热线问一下，不一定非得去急诊。
en: If your symptoms are fairly mild, try ringing Healthline first — you don't necessarily need to go to ED.
alt: If it's only mild, call Healthline first; you might not need to go to A&E.
point: “不一定非得”是 don't necessarily need to

zh: 我们搬进去之前，房东答应找人把地毯洗了，还会把漏水的水龙头修好。
en: Before we move in, the landlord's agreed to get the carpets cleaned and sort out the leaky tap.
point: before 后用现在时；“找人洗”用 get + 宾语 + 过去分词

zh: 我不在家的这几天，你能不能帮我浇浇花，顺便看看有没有快递？
en: While I'm away, could you water the plants and check if any parcels turn up?
point: “不在家的这几天”是 while I'm away；“有没有”用 check if

zh: 那天晚上你要是实在过不来也没关系，等你下次回奥克兰我们再聚。
en: No worries if you can't make it that night — we'll catch up next time you're back in Auckland.
point: “过不来”是 can't make it；next time 本身就是连词，不再加 when

zh: 我们刚到他家没多久就下起了大雨，只好把东西全搬进车库。
en: We'd only just got to their place when it started bucketing down, so we had to move everything into the garage.
point: “刚…就…”用 had only just … when；下大雨 bucketing down

zh: 签合同之前，最好先找个会计帮你看一下，免得以后在税上吃亏。
en: Before you sign anything, get an accountant to look it over, otherwise you might get caught out on tax later.
point: “免得…吃亏”用 otherwise … get caught out

zh: 银行一批贷款，我们就跟卖家把交房日期定下来。
en: Once the bank approves the loan, we'll lock in the settlement date with the seller.
alt: As soon as the loan's approved, we'll confirm the settlement date with the vendor.
point: “一…就…”用 once / as soon as；新西兰买房交割叫 settlement

zh: 下班前把这个发给我。
en: Send me this before you knock off.
alt: Send this to me before you finish for the day.
point: “下班前”是 before you knock off，before 后要补主语

zh: 密码忘了就点这里。
en: If you forget your password, click here.
alt: Click here if you've forgotten your password.
point: “忘了就…”英文要补 if 和主语 you

zh: 人到齐了再点菜吧。
en: Let's order when everyone's here.
alt: Let's wait till everyone's here to order.
point: “人到齐”是 everyone's here，when 后用现在时

zh: 器材用完请擦干净。
en: Please wipe the machine down after you use it.
alt: Wipe down the equipment when you're done.
point: “用完”是 after you use it / when you're done

zh: 你排队的时候我去拿个篮子。
en: I'll grab a basket while you queue.
alt: You line up and I'll get a basket.
point: 同时进行的“…的时候”用 while

zh: 登机前记得给手机充好电。
en: Make sure your phone's charged before you board.
point: “登机前”是 before you board；“充好电”用 charged

zh: 疼得厉害就吃一片。
en: Take one if the pain gets bad.
alt: If it really hurts, take a tablet.
point: “疼得厉害”是 the pain gets bad；“就”不翻

zh: 水开了叫我一声。
en: Give me a shout when the jug boils.
alt: Let me know when the kettle's boiled.
point: “水开了”指将来，用 when + 现在时；Kiwi 管电水壶叫 jug

zh: 我们要是迟到了，你们就先开始吧。
en: If we're late, just start without us.
point: “先开始”是 start without us，不是 first start

zh: 刷卡不行的话我就付现金。
en: I'll pay cash if my card doesn't work.
alt: If the card gets declined, I'll pay cash.
point: “刷卡不行”是 my card doesn't work / gets declined

zh: 面试结束了跟我说说怎么样。
en: Tell me how it went after the interview.
alt: Let me know how you got on after your interview.
point: “面试结束了”用 after the interview；“怎么样”是 how it went

zh: 有消息我就通知你。
en: I'll let you know as soon as I hear anything.
alt: I'll be in touch once I hear back.
point: “有消息”是 hear anything；as soon as 后不用 will

zh: 简历改好了发给我看看。
en: Send me your CV once you've updated it.
alt: Send your CV through when you've finished updating it.
point: “改好了”用 once + 现在完成时 you've updated

zh: 考试开始前把手机关掉。
en: Turn your phones off before the exam starts.
point: before 后用现在时 starts，不说 will start

zh: 下课了我们去图书馆吧。
en: Let's go to the library when class finishes.
alt: Let's hit the library after class.
point: “下课了”是 when class finishes / after class

zh: 不懂就问老师。
en: If you don't understand, ask the tutor.
alt: Ask the teacher if you're not sure.
point: 中文无主语，英文要 if + you

zh: 搬走前要打扫干净。
en: You need to clean the place before you move out.
alt: The place has to be cleaned before you move out.
point: “搬走”是 move out；before 后要补主语

zh: 看完房告诉我你觉得怎么样。
en: Tell me what you think after the viewing.
alt: Let me know what you reckon once you've seen the place.
point: 看房叫 viewing；“看完房”用 after the viewing

zh: 房东同意了才能签。
en: We can't sign until the landlord agrees.
alt: We have to wait for the landlord to say yes before we sign.
point: “…了才能…”用 can't … until

zh: 他们家狗一叫我就醒。
en: I wake up whenever their dog barks.
alt: Every time their dog barks, I wake up.
point: 每次都发生的“一…就…”用 whenever

zh: 我不在的时候能帮我收个快递吗？
en: Can you grab my parcel while I'm out?
alt: Could you take in my parcel while I'm not home?
point: “我不在的时候”是 while I'm out

zh: 太吵的话我就去敲门。
en: If it's too loud, I'll knock on their door.
point: if 后用现在时 is，will 只放主句

zh: 停电了先看看电闸。
en: If the power goes out, check the switchboard first.
alt: Check the fuse box first if the power cuts out.
point: “停电”是 the power goes out，要补 if

zh: 账单来了我转给你。
en: I'll forward the bill when it comes.
alt: I'll send you the bill once it arrives.
point: “账单来了”是将来，用 when it comes

zh: 等网好了我再打给你。
en: I'll call you back once the internet's back up.
alt: I'll ring you when the Wi-Fi's working again.
point: “网好了”说 the internet's back up，不说 net good

zh: 水管工到了叫我。
en: Call me when the plumber turns up.
alt: Give me a ring once the plumber's here.
point: “到了”用 turns up，when 后不用 will

zh: 修之前先给个报价吧。
en: Can you give me a quote before you start?
point: 报价是 quote；“修之前”用 before you start

zh: 洗衣机再坏的话就换台新的。
en: If the washing machine breaks again, we'll get a new one.
point: “的话”就是 if，从句用现在时 breaks

zh: 表填完交给前台。
en: Hand the form in at reception once it's filled in.
alt: When you've filled in the form, give it to reception.
point: “填完”是 once it's filled in；交表 hand in

zh: 护照过期前记得续。
en: Renew your passport before it expires.
alt: Don't forget to renew your passport before it runs out.
point: before 后要完整从句 it expires

zh: 签证一批下来我就订机票。
en: I'll book flights as soon as my visa comes through.
alt: Once my visa's approved, I'll book the flights.
point: “批下来”是 comes through；as soon as 后用现在时

zh: 闻到煤气味就马上出去。
en: If you smell gas, get out straight away.
point: “闻到…就…”用 if；“马上”是 straight away

zh: 地震的时候躲到桌子底下。
en: If there's an earthquake, get under a table.
alt: Get under a table when an earthquake hits.
point: “地震的时候”要补 there's：if there's an earthquake

zh: 救护车来之前别动他。
en: Don't move him until the ambulance gets here.
point: “…之前别…”常说 don't … until

zh: 绿灯了再走。
en: Don't go until the light's green.
alt: Wait till the light turns green.
point: “…了再…”用 don't … until

zh: 加完油我们就出发。
en: We'll head off once we've filled up.
alt: We'll get going after we fill up.
point: 加油是 fill up；once + 现在完成时

zh: 路上结冰就别开车了。
en: Don't drive if the roads are icy.
point: “结冰”说 the roads are icy；if 从句可放句尾

zh: 太阳下山前我们得下山。
en: We need to get down before the sun goes down.
alt: We should be off the hill before sunset.
point: 太阳“下山”是 the sun goes down，before 后要从句

zh: 出门前抹点防晒。
en: Slap on some sunscreen before you go outside.
alt: Put some sunblock on before you head out.
point: “抹”是 put on / slap on；before 后补主语 you

zh: 天气好的话我们去海边。
en: If the weather's nice, let's go to the beach.
alt: Let's hit the beach if it's a nice day.
point: “天气好的话”是 if the weather's nice

zh: 电影开始前把手机调静音。
en: Put your phone on silent before the movie starts.
point: 静音是 on silent；before 后用现在时 starts

zh: 看完这集我就睡。
en: I'll go to bed once this episode finishes.
alt: I'm going to bed after this episode.
point: “看完这集”是 once this episode finishes

zh: 还有票的话我们一起去。
en: If there are tickets left, let's go together.
point: “有票”是 there are tickets left，不说 have tickets

zh: 她进来之前大家都藏好。
en: Everyone hide until she walks in.
alt: Everyone stay hidden till she comes in.
point: “…之前藏好”其实是一直藏到她进来：until

zh: 你圣诞节回来的话我们聚一聚。
en: If you're back for Christmas, let's catch up.
point: “回来过圣诞”是 back for Christmas；聚一聚 catch up

zh: 拆礼物之前先看卡片。
en: Read the card before you open the present.
point: 拆礼物是 open the present；before 后要从句

zh: 作业做完才能玩游戏。
en: No games until your homework's done.
alt: You can play games after you've finished your homework.
point: “做完…才能”用 not … until

zh: 放学了我去接你。
en: I'll pick you up when school finishes.
alt: I'll come and get you after school.
point: “放学了”是 when school finishes / after school

zh: 奶奶一到我们就开饭。
en: We'll eat as soon as Grandma gets here.
point: as soon as 后用现在时 gets，不用 will get

zh: 出门前给狗喂饭。
en: Feed the dog before you go.
alt: Give the dog his dinner before you leave.
point: before 后要从句 you go，不说 before go out

zh: 它这样叫就是饿了。
en: When she meows like that, she's hungry.
alt: If she's meowing like that, she wants food.
point: 习惯性的“…就是…”用 when；宠物常用 she/he

zh: 它不咬人，除非你踩到它尾巴。
en: He doesn't bite unless you tread on his tail.
point: “除非”是 unless，unless 后用现在时

zh: 难过就哭出来吧。
en: It's okay to cry if you're sad.
alt: If you need a cry, let it out.
point: “难过就…”用 if you're sad，“吧”不用翻

zh: 我一紧张就说错话。
en: I always say the wrong thing when I'm nervous.
alt: Whenever I get nervous, I say the wrong thing.
point: 习惯性的“一…就…”用 when / whenever

zh: 等你冷静下来我们再谈。
en: We'll talk when you've calmed down.
alt: Let's talk once you've cooled off.
point: 冷静下来 calm down；when + 现在完成时

zh: 我在开会的时候，别把电话转进来。
en: Don't put any calls through while I'm in the meeting.
alt: Please hold my calls while I'm in the meeting.
point: “在…的时候”用 while；转电话是 put through

zh: 我们升级系统期间，网站大概会停一个小时。
en: The site will be down for about an hour while we upgrade the system.
point: “期间”用 while + 现在时；网站停了是 be down

zh: 你们十分钟后还没到的话，我们就先点了。
en: If you're not here in ten minutes, we'll go ahead and order.
alt: We'll start ordering if you're not here in ten minutes.
point: “十分钟后”是 in ten minutes；“先点”说 go ahead and order

zh: 只要不下雨，周六的比赛照常进行。
en: Saturday's game is still on as long as it doesn't rain.
alt: As long as it stays dry, Saturday's match is going ahead.
point: “只要”是 as long as；“照常进行”说 still on

zh: 下次你去 Kmart，帮我看看有没有那种小书架。
en: Next time you're at Kmart, can you see if they've got those little shelves?
point: next time 本身当连词用，不要再加 when

zh: 等我们过完海关，行李早就在转盘上了。
en: By the time we got through customs, our bags were already on the carousel.
point: “等…的时候早就…”用 by the time；转盘 carousel

zh: 药吃完了还没好的话，再回来看一下。
en: If you're not better when you finish the pills, come back and see me.
point: if 和 when 两个从句都用现在时

zh: 周四晚上睡觉前记得把垃圾桶推出去。
en: Remember to put the bins out on Thursday night before you go to bed.
point: 推垃圾桶出去是 put the bins out；before + 从句

zh: 你在附近的话，随时过来坐坐。
en: Pop in any time you're in the area.
alt: Feel free to drop by whenever you're nearby.
point: “…的话随时”用 any time + 从句；过来坐坐 pop in

zh: 转账之前再核对一下账号。
en: Double-check the account number before you transfer the money.
point: “再核对一下”是 double-check；before 后补主语

zh: 下周还没收到回复的话，我就打电话问问。
en: If I haven't heard back by next week, I'll give them a call.
alt: I'll ring them if there's no word by next week.
point: “还没收到回复”用 if + 现在完成时 haven't heard back

zh: 签合同之前一定要看清楚试用期的条款。
en: Read the trial period clause carefully before you sign the contract.
point: “签…之前”是 before you sign；试用期 trial period

zh: 我一拿到 offer 就递辞职信。
en: I'll hand in my notice the moment I get the offer.
alt: As soon as the offer comes through, I'm resigning.
point: “一…就…”也可用 the moment；辞职 hand in my notice

zh: 等我雅思考到7分，我就申请硕士。
en: Once I get a 7 in IELTS, I'll apply for a master's.
point: once 后用现在时 get，不用 will get

zh: 我读书那几年一直在咖啡馆打工。
en: I worked in a café the whole time I was studying.
alt: I had a café job all the way through my studies.
point: “…那几年一直”用 the whole time + 过去进行时

zh: 截止日期前交不了的话，要提前跟老师申请延期。
en: If you can't hand it in by the deadline, ask your tutor for an extension beforehand.
point: “申请延期”是 ask for an extension；“截止前”by the deadline

zh: 签约之前我们想先看看房子白天采光怎么样。
en: Before we sign, we'd like to see how much sun the place gets during the day.
point: “采光”说 how much sun it gets；before 后用现在时

zh: 房东说要等退房检查完才退押金。
en: The landlord says we won't get our bond back until after the final inspection.
point: “要等…才…”用 won't … until；押金叫 bond

zh: 新室友搬进来之前，我们得把空房间收拾出来。
en: We need to clear out the spare room before the new flatmate moves in.
point: “收拾出来”是 clear out；室友叫 flatmate

zh: 隔壁装修那段时间，我们白天基本不在家。
en: We're mostly out during the day while next door's renovating.
point: “那段时间”用 while + 进行时；隔壁 next door

zh: 猫今晚还没回来的话，我们就在社区群里发个帖子。
en: If the cat still isn't back tonight, we'll post in the neighbourhood Facebook group.
point: “还没回来”是 still isn't back；if 后不用 will

zh: 你什么时候要用割草机，直接过来拿就行。
en: If you ever need the lawnmower, just come and grab it.
alt: Feel free to borrow the mower whenever you need it.
point: “什么时候要用”说 if you ever need，不是 what time

zh: 搬进去之前得先把电和网开通。
en: We need to get the power and internet sorted before we move in.
point: “开通”说 get … sorted / connected

zh: 这个月账单要是比平时高很多，就打电话问问。
en: If this month's bill is way higher than usual, give them a ring.
point: “比平时高很多”是 way higher than usual

zh: 昨天他们修线路的时候，整条街都停电了。
en: The whole street lost power while they were fixing the lines yesterday.
point: 过去的“…的时候”用 while + 过去进行时

zh: 师傅说零件到了才能修洗碗机。
en: The technician says he can't fix the dishwasher until the part arrives.
point: “…到了才能”用 can't … until，until 后用现在时

zh: 电工在这儿的时候，顺便让他看看那个插座。
en: While the electrician's here, let's get him to check that socket too.
point: “顺便”可用 while … here 表达；让他看 get him to check

zh: 报价超过两千块的话，我得先跟房东商量。
en: If the quote's over two grand, I'll need to run it past the landlord first.
point: “跟…商量”说 run it past；两千块 two grand

zh: 你去邮局的话，帮我把这封信寄了吧。
en: If you're going to the post office, could you post this letter for me?
point: “去…的话”用 if you're going to，进行时表计划

zh: 来预约的时候记得带上护照和地址证明。
en: Bring your passport and proof of address when you come to your appointment.
point: “…的时候记得带”用 when you come；地址证明 proof of address

zh: 上个月把表寄出去以后，到现在还没消息。
en: I still haven't heard anything since I sent the form off last month.
point: “…以后到现在”用 since，主句用现在完成时

zh: 我昨晚回到家，发现门被人撬了。
en: When I got home last night, I found the door had been forced open.
point: 过去的 when 用过去时；被撬 had been forced open

zh: 暴风雨过去之前尽量别出门。
en: Try to stay inside until the storm passes.
alt: Stay indoors till the storm's blown over.
point: “…之前别出门”英文常说 stay inside until

zh: 抽屉里有手电筒，万一停电可以用。
en: There's a torch in the drawer in case the power goes out.
point: 预防性的“万一”用 in case；手电筒叫 torch

zh: 等车少一点再走吧，现在太堵了。
en: Let's wait until the traffic dies down a bit, it's chocka right now.
alt: Let's hang on till the traffic eases off, it's jammed at the moment.
point: “车少了”是 traffic dies down；“堵”Kiwi 说 chocka

zh: WOF 过期之前记得约个时间去检查。
en: Book the car in for a WOF before the current one runs out.
point: “过期前”是 before … runs out；预约检车 book the car in

zh: 我开车的时候别给我发信息，我不会回的。
en: Don't text me while I'm driving, I won't reply.
alt: Don't message me when I'm behind the wheel, I won't answer.
point: “…的时候”正在做的事用 while + 进行时

zh: 天气要是变坏了，我们就往回走。
en: If the weather turns, we'll head back.
alt: We'll turn around if the weather packs in.
point: “天气变坏”说 the weather turns；往回走 head back

zh: 下水之前先看看有没有离岸流。
en: Check for rips before you go in the water.
point: 离岸流叫 rip；“下水”是 go in the water

zh: 我们在山脊上的时候，雾一下子就起来了。
en: The fog rolled in really quickly while we were up on the ridge.
point: 过去的“…的时候”用 while we were；雾起来 roll in

zh: 那本书你看完能借我吗？
en: Can I borrow that book when you've finished it?
alt: Could I borrow that book once you're done with it?
point: when + 现在完成时 you've finished，表示看完以后

zh: 演唱会的票一开卖就被抢光了。
en: The concert sold out the moment tickets went on sale.
alt: Tickets were gone as soon as they went on sale.
point: 过去的“一…就…”用 the moment + 过去时；抢光 sold out

zh: 下次剪头发我想剪短一点。
en: Next time I get my hair cut, I want it a bit shorter.
point: 剪头发是 get my hair cut；next time 当连词

zh: 我们家一般到除夕晚上才包饺子。
en: We don't usually make dumplings until New Year's Eve.
point: “到…才…”用 not … until，不说 only then

zh: 仪式进行的时候请把手机收起来。
en: Please put your phones away while the ceremony's on.
point: “进行的时候”是 while … is on；收起来 put away

zh: 你生日那天要是有空，我们出去吃饭吧。
en: If you're free on your birthday, let's go out for dinner.
point: “生日那天”是 on your birthday；if 后用现在时

zh: 孩子们睡着以后我才有时间看书。
en: I don't get any time to read until the kids are asleep.
point: “…以后才…”用 not … until

zh: 我小时候每个周末都去外婆家。
en: When I was little, we went to Grandma's every weekend.
alt: We used to go to Nana's every weekend when I was a kid.
point: “小时候”是 when I was little，不说 small time

zh: 他要是发烧了，就让他在家别去学校。
en: If he's got a temperature, keep him home from school.
point: 发烧可说 has a temperature；“在家别去”keep him home

zh: 我们去度假的时候，邻居帮我们喂猫。
en: Our neighbour feeds the cat while we're on holiday.
alt: The neighbours look after the cat when we go away.
point: “…的时候”用 while we're on holiday

zh: 带狗去海滩之前，先查一下那里让不让狗进。
en: Check if dogs are allowed before you take him to the beach.
point: “让不让”用 check if … allowed

zh: 只要你每天遛它，它就不会乱咬东西。
en: As long as you walk him every day, he won't chew things.
point: “只要…就…”用 as long as，从句用现在时

zh: 我一想到明天的演讲就紧张。
en: I get nervous every time I think about tomorrow's speech.
alt: Just thinking about tomorrow's speech makes me nervous.
point: “一想到就”是 every time I think about

zh: 说实话，你那天说那句话的时候我挺受伤的。
en: To be honest, I was pretty hurt when you said that.
point: 过去的 when 用过去时；“受伤”是 hurt，不是 injured

zh: 别担心，等你习惯了就好了。
en: Don't worry, it gets easier once you get used to it.
point: “等…就好了”用 once + 现在时 get used to

zh: 早知道会议取消了，我就不用这么早来公司了。
en: If I'd known the meeting was cancelled, I wouldn't have come in so early.
alt: Had I known the meeting was off, I wouldn't have come in this early.
point: “早知道…就不…”是对过去的假设：if I'd known … wouldn't have

zh: 趁老板休假，我们把积压的工单清一清。
en: While the boss is on leave, let's get through the backlog of tickets.
alt: Let's clear the backlog while the boss is away.
point: “趁…”常用 while；积压的工作 backlog

zh: 除非经理批准，不然谁都不能在家办公。
en: Nobody can work from home unless their manager signs off on it.
point: “除非…不然”只用 unless；批准 sign off on

zh: 你每次改密码，记得把手机上的也一起更新。
en: Whenever you change your password, remember to update it on your phone as well.
point: “每次…”用 whenever，不说 every time when

zh: 我要是你，重装系统之前会先把照片备份到云上。
en: If I were you, I'd back up your photos to the cloud before reinstalling.
alt: I'd save your photos to the cloud before you reinstall, if I were you.
point: 给建议用 If I were you, I'd；before 后可接 -ing

zh: 等我发现中了病毒，文件已经全被加密了。
en: By the time I noticed the virus, all my files had already been encrypted.
point: by the time + 过去时，主句用过去完成时

zh: 就算这次没拿到，这次面试也是很好的锻炼。
en: Even if I don't get the job, the interview's still good practice.
point: “就算”是 even if，后面用现在时，不用 will

zh: 既然你已经辞职了，就好好休息一个月吧。
en: Now that you've quit, why not take a month off to recharge?
point: “既然”可用 now that；休息一个月 take a month off

zh: 他们要等背景调查做完，才会发正式合同。
en: They won't send the formal contract until the reference checks are done.
point: “要等…才…”用 won't … until；背景调查叫 reference checks

zh: 我要是早点开始复习，现在就不会这么慌了。
en: If I'd started revising earlier, I wouldn't be panicking like this now.
point: 过去没做导致现在：if I'd started … wouldn't be

zh: 只要你每节课都来，及格应该没问题。
en: As long as you turn up to every class, you should pass without any trouble.
point: “只要”是 as long as；“来上课”说 turn up to class

zh: 图书馆关门前我得把这几本书还了，不然要被罚款。
en: I need to return these books before the library closes, otherwise I'll get a fine.
point: “不然”用 otherwise；before 后用现在时 closes

zh: 汤快开的时候把火调小。
en: Turn the heat down just before the soup comes to the boil.
alt: When the soup's about to boil, turn the heat down.
point: “快…的时候”是 just before / when … about to

zh: 就算再忙，我们每周也要大扫除一次。
en: Even if we're flat out, we still do a proper clean once a week.
point: “就算再忙”是 even if we're flat out，主句加 still

zh: 湿衣服要是一直放在洗衣机里不拿出来，很快就有味道了。
en: If you leave wet clothes sitting in the washing machine, they start to smell pretty quickly.
point: 一般规律：if 和主句都用现在时

zh: 既然租约下个月就到期了，我们得决定续不续。
en: Since our lease runs out next month, we need to decide whether to renew.
point: “既然”用 since；租约到期 runs out；“续不续”whether to

zh: 我们看了十几套房子，才找到合适的。
en: We'd looked at over a dozen places before we found the right one.
point: “才”用 before；先发生的事用过去完成时 we'd looked

zh: 要是房租能便宜五十块，我们今天就签。
en: If they'd drop the rent by fifty bucks, we'd sign today.
alt: We'd sign today if the rent came down by fifty dollars.
point: 假设性的条件用 if they'd / came … we'd

zh: 他们每次开派对，我们都要到凌晨两点才睡得着。
en: Every time they have a party, we can't get to sleep until 2 am.
point: “到…才…”用 can't … until；every time 当连词

zh: 篱笆要是真倒了，修的钱我们两家平摊吧。
en: If the fence does come down, let's split the cost of fixing it.
point: “要是真…”用 does 加强；平摊 split the cost

zh: 我刚搬来的时候，隔壁老太太还给我送了一盘饼干。
en: When I first moved in, the old lady next door brought me a plate of biscuits.
point: “刚…的时候”用 when I first，不说 just moved

zh: 网速要是一直这么慢，合同一到期我就换一家。
en: If the internet stays this slow, I'm switching providers as soon as my contract ends.
point: if 和 as soon as 两个从句都用现在时

zh: 我等了四十分钟才有客服接电话。
en: I was on hold for forty minutes before anyone picked up.
alt: It took forty minutes on hold before I got through to someone.
point: “等了…才…”用 before；电话等待叫 on hold

zh: 出门的时候把暖气关了，不然电费会很高。
en: Switch the heater off when you go out, or the power bill will be huge.
point: “不然”用 or；电费叫 power bill

zh: 水管工来之前，先把总阀关掉。
en: Before the plumber gets here, turn the water off at the mains.
point: before 后用现在时；“总阀关掉”是 turn off at the mains

zh: 反正最后还得叫人来修，还不如现在就叫。
en: If you're going to end up calling someone anyway, you might as well do it now.
point: “还不如”用 might as well；if 后可用 be going to

zh: 热水器修好之前，我们只能去健身房洗澡。
en: Until the hot water's fixed, we'll have to shower at the gym.
point: until 放句首也行；“只能”是 have to

zh: 你要是拿不准尺码，就两个都买，回头退一个。
en: If you're not sure about the size, get both and take one back later.
point: “拿不准”是 not sure；“回头退”take back later

zh: 等我到了，打折的东西早就被抢光了。
en: By the time I got there, all the specials had been snapped up.
point: by the time + 过去，主句用过去完成；抢光 snapped up

zh: 快递送来的时候如果箱子坏了，就别签收。
en: If the box is damaged when the courier turns up, don't sign for it.
point: 签收是 sign for；if 和 when 都用现在时

zh: 你要是对坚果过敏，点菜的时候一定要说。
en: If you're allergic to nuts, make sure you tell them when you order.
point: “一定要说”用 make sure you tell；when 后用现在时

zh: 周五晚上不提前订的话，基本没位子。
en: Unless you book ahead, you won't get a table on a Friday night.
alt: You'll struggle to get a table on a Friday night if you don't book.
point: “不…的话”可用 unless，主句用否定

zh: 我们刚点完菜，服务员就说那道鱼卖完了。
en: We'd just ordered when the waiter told us the fish had run out.
point: “刚…就…”用 had just … when；卖完了 run out

zh: 要是有人打电话让你转账，先挂了再自己打给银行核实。
en: If someone rings asking you to transfer money, hang up and call the bank yourself.
point: if 后用现在时 rings；“核实”在这里不必直译

zh: 首付存够了我们才开始看房。
en: We won't start looking at houses until we've saved the deposit.
point: “…了才…”用 won't … until + 现在完成时

zh: 我要是早几年开始存 KiwiSaver，现在就能多攒不少了。
en: If I'd started KiwiSaver earlier, I'd have a lot more saved by now.
point: 混合条件句：if I'd started（过去）… I'd have（现在）

zh: 搬家以后记得更新选民登记的地址。
en: Remember to update your address on the electoral roll after you move.
point: after 后用现在时 move；选民登记 electoral roll

zh: 续签别拖到最后一刻，签证到期前早点申请。
en: Don't leave your visa renewal until the last minute, apply well before it expires.
point: “拖到最后”是 leave … until the last minute；well before

zh: 表格要是填错了，整个申请都会被退回来。
en: If you fill the form in wrong, the whole application gets sent back.
point: 一般规律用 if + 现在时；被退回 gets sent back

zh: 这个药吃了要是头晕，就别开车。
en: If this medication makes you dizzy, don't get behind the wheel.
point: “吃了头晕”是 makes you dizzy；开车 get behind the wheel

zh: 我昨天在急诊等了三个小时才看上医生。
en: I waited three hours in ED yesterday before I got seen.
point: “等了…才…”用 before；“看上医生”是 got seen

zh: 等肿消了，牙医才能把那颗牙拔掉。
en: Once the swelling goes down, the dentist can take the tooth out.
point: “肿消了”是 the swelling goes down；拔牙 take out

zh: 钱包要是丢了，第一件事就是把卡全冻结。
en: If you ever lose your wallet, cancel your cards before you do anything else.
point: “第一件事”用 before you do anything else 表达

zh: 我们正在停车，就听见有人喊着火了。
en: We were just parking when we heard someone yell that there was a fire.
point: 进行中的事被打断：过去进行时 + when

zh: 等摇晃停了再出去，别急着往外跑。
en: Wait until the shaking stops before you go outside, don't rush out.
point: “等…再…”是 wait until … before

zh: 错过这个出口的话，你得再开十公里才能掉头。
en: If you miss this exit, you'll have to drive another ten k before you can turn around.
point: “才能”用 before you can；公里口语说 k

zh: 等我们到了停车楼，车位已经全满了。

zh: 这个周末要是天气给面子，我们终于可以把车库那堆东西清一清了，都拖了好几个月了。
en: If the weather plays ball this weekend, we can finally tackle the mess in the garage. We've been putting it off for months.
point: “天气给面子”是 the weather plays ball；拖着 put off

zh: 我们刚把客厅刷完漆，孩子们就拿蜡笔在墙上画了一大片。
en: No sooner had we finished painting the lounge than the kids drew all over the wall in crayon.
point: “刚…就…”的强调说法：No sooner had … than

zh: 我们不是想找麻烦，但如果下周之前还没人来看漏水的屋顶，我们可能只能走正式程序了。
en: We're not trying to make trouble, but if nobody's looked at the leaking roof by next week, we may have to take it further.
point: if + 现在完成时；“走正式程序”说 take it further 更委婉

zh: 房东老说等他有空就来修，可这话他已经说了两个月了。
en: The landlord keeps saying he'll sort it once he gets a chance, but he's been saying that for two months now.
point: “等他有空”是 once he gets a chance；“老说”keeps saying

zh: 想顺顺利利拿回押金的话，搬走前最好把房子收拾得比你刚搬进来时还干净。
en: If you want your bond back without any hassle, leave the place cleaner than it was when you moved in.
point: “顺顺利利”是 without any hassle；比较里也藏着 when 从句

zh: 我们不想小题大做，但他们家的狗每天一过半夜就叫个不停，有没有什么委婉的办法跟他们提？
en: We don't want to make a fuss, but their dog barks its head off every night once it's past midnight. Is there a tactful way to raise it?
point: “小题大做”make a fuss；“叫个不停”barks its head off

zh: 他们要是再把车堵在我们车道口，我真的要忍不住了，我到现在已经够有耐心了。
en: If they park across our driveway one more time, I'm honestly going to lose it, and I've been really patient so far.
point: “再…一次”是 one more time；“忍不住”lose it

zh: 等他们家终于装修完，我们得请他们过来喝一杯，毕竟这几个月大家都在互相忍着。
en: Once their renovation's finally wrapped up, we should have them over for a drink, since we've all been putting up with each other for months.
point: “完工”wrapped up；“互相忍着”putting up with each other

zh: 我不是想为难你，但这已经是我第三次打电话了，每次都说会有人回电，结果从来没人打过来。
en: I don't mean to give you a hard time, but this is my third call, and every time I'm told someone will ring back, nobody ever does.
point: 先缓和 I don't mean to give you a hard time，再用 every time 抱怨

zh: 说不定冬天一过电费就降下来了，所以我们先别急着换公司。
en: The power bill might well come down once winter's over, so let's not rush into switching companies just yet.
point: “说不定”用 might well；once 后用现在时

zh: 如果你们没法保证下周之前修好，那我只能考虑换一家了，虽然我也不太想这样。
en: If you can't promise it'll be fixed by next week, I'll have no option but to look elsewhere, though I'd really rather not.
point: “只能考虑换一家”是 no option but to look elsewhere

zh: 他说两个小时就能搞定，不过按我的经验，等他真修好估计天都黑了。
en: He reckons it'll only take a couple of hours, but in my experience it'll be dark by the time he's actually finished.
point: by the time + 现在完成时，主句用将来

zh: 既然墙都拆开了，不如趁机把旧电线也换了，省得以后再折腾一遍。
en: While the wall's open anyway, we might as well get the old wiring replaced, so we're not doing it all over again down the track.
point: “趁机”用 while … anyway；“以后”Kiwi 常说 down the track

zh: 如果他们的报价比别家贵一大截，你决定用不用他们之前，至少得问问为什么。
en: If their quote's miles above everyone else's, I'd at least ask them to justify it before you decide whether to go with them.
point: “贵一大截”miles above；before 后用现在时

zh: 我也不是非退不可，但如果你们能便宜一点，这件有个小污点的我就留着了。
en: I'm not desperate to send it back, but if you could knock a bit off, I'd happily keep it despite the small mark.
point: “便宜一点”是 knock a bit off；if you could … I'd

zh: 等你真需要咖啡机的时候再买吧，不然它就跟那台面包机一样，放在柜子里吃灰。
en: Wait until you actually need a coffee machine before buying one, or it'll end up gathering dust in the cupboard like the bread maker.
point: wait until … before；“吃灰”gathering dust

zh: 那条裙子我犹豫了半天没买，等我回去找的时候已经卖光了，现在肠子都悔青了。
en: I dithered over that dress, and by the time I went back for it, it had sold out. I'm kicking myself now.
point: by the time + 过去完成；“悔青肠子”kicking myself

zh: 如果厨房那边不方便就算了，不过这道菜能不能不放洋葱？
en: If it's too much of a hassle for the kitchen, don't worry, but would it be possible to leave the onion out of this one?
point: 先给对方台阶 if it's too much of a hassle；去掉 leave out

zh: 我不想显得太挑剔，但如果主菜还要很久，我们可能就不吃了，八点还要去看电影。
en: I don't want to be a pain, but unless our mains are nearly ready, we might have to skip them, as we've got a movie at eight.
point: “如果还要很久”反过来说 unless … nearly ready

zh: 下次要是再来这家，一定得提前订位，上次等了四十分钟，我差点饿晕过去。
en: If we ever come back here, let's book ahead. Last time we waited forty minutes for a table and I nearly fainted from hunger.
point: “下次要是再来”用 if we ever come back

zh: 钱借给他倒没什么，只是借之前得先弄清楚他什么时候能还，免得到时候伤了和气。
en: I don't mind lending him the money, but I'd want to know when he can pay it back before I do, so it doesn't sour things between us.
point: before I do 省略重复动词；“伤和气”sour things

zh: 现在房价这么不稳定，我要是你，就等市场稳一点再出手。
en: With prices all over the place at the moment, I'd sit tight until the market settles down a bit before making a move, if I were you.
point: “先按兵不动”sit tight until；“出手”make a move

zh: 一开始只是偶尔用一下先买后付，结果不知不觉就欠了一屁股债。
en: It started with the odd buy-now-pay-later purchase, and before I knew it I was up to my eyeballs in debt.
point: “不知不觉”before I knew it；“一屁股债”up to my eyeballs in debt

zh: 这种表一般第一次都过不了，所以你最好在截止日期前多留点时间，以防被打回来。
en: These forms rarely go through first time, so I'd leave yourself plenty of time before the deadline in case it gets bounced back.
point: in case 后用现在时；“被打回来”gets bounced back

zh: 我不是想催你们，但我的签证下个月就到期了，要是到时候还没办下来，我心里真有点没底。
en: I don't want to hassle you, but my visa runs out next month, and I'm getting a bit anxious about what happens if it isn't sorted by then.
point: 委婉催促：I don't want to hassle you；“到时候”by then

zh: 等你跟他们多打几次交道就知道了，打电话往往比发邮件快得多。
en: Once you've dealt with them a few times, you'll find that picking up the phone gets things moving far quicker than email.
point: once + 现在完成时；“办得快”gets things moving

zh: 我知道你不爱看医生，但如果这周过完咳嗽还没好，你真得去让医生看看了。
en: I know you hate going to the doctor, but if that cough hasn't cleared up by the end of the week, you really need to get it looked at.
point: if + 现在完成时 hasn't cleared up；“让人看看”get it looked at

zh: 你先别自己吓自己，等结果出来再说，现在想太多也没用。
en: Try not to get ahead of yourself. Let's wait until the results come back, because there's no point worrying until we know more.
point: “自己吓自己”get ahead of yourself；两个 until 都用现在时

zh: 我本来以为只是扭了一下，直到拍了片子才知道骨头裂了。
en: I thought I'd just twisted it, and it wasn't until I had an X-ray that I found out it was actually fractured.
point: 强调“直到…才”用 it wasn't until … that

zh: 希望永远用不上，但还是把应急包准备好吧，真来大地震的时候可没时间到处找东西。
en: Hopefully we'll never need it, but let's put an emergency kit together, because if a big quake hits, we won't have time to hunt for stuff.
point: if 后用现在时 hits；“准备好”put together

zh: 我当时完全没意识到出事了，直到看见邻居们都跑到街上，才反应过来。
en: I had no idea anything was wrong until I saw all the neighbours out on the street, and then the penny dropped.
point: “反应过来”是 the penny dropped；had no idea … until

zh: 最坏的情况就是我们得撤离几天，所以重要证件最好提前装进一个包里，拿起来就能走。
en: If worst comes to worst and we have to evacuate for a few days, it'd be good to have the important documents in one bag, ready to grab.
point: “最坏的情况”是 if worst comes to worst

zh: 你要是不介意绕点路，我们可以避开市中心，等高峰过了再上高速。
en: If you don't mind going the long way round, we could avoid the CBD and only jump on the motorway once rush hour's died down.
point: “等…再”用 only … once；高峰过了 rush hour dies down

zh: 我刚开始变道，旁边就有辆车飞快地冲了上来，真是险得要命。
en: Hardly had I started to change lanes when a car came flying up on my inside. It was a seriously close call.
point: “刚…就…”的倒装 Hardly had … when；“好险”close call

zh: 说是二十分钟车程，但要是赶上下班高峰，没一个小时根本到不了。
en: It's meant to be a twenty-minute drive, but if you get caught in the after-work rush, you won't get there in under an hour.
point: “说是”it's meant to be；“赶上高峰”get caught in the rush

zh: 到时候看情况再定吧，要是南边天气不好，我们大不了在惠灵顿多住一晚。
en: Let's play it by ear. If the weather's rubbish down there, we can always stay an extra night in Wellington.
point: “看情况再定”是 play it by ear；“大不了”can always

zh: 直到到了机场我们才发现护照还在家里抽屉里，那一刻我真想找个地缝钻进去。
en: It wasn't until we got to the airport that we realised our passports were still in the drawer at home. I wanted the ground to swallow me up.
point: it wasn't until … that 强调；“找地缝钻”the ground to swallow me up

zh: 过年的机票一定要早点订，等你想起来的时候，价格早就翻倍了。
en: You really need to book flights well before New Year, because by the time it occurs to you, the prices will have doubled.
point: by the time + 现在时，主句用将来完成时 will have doubled

zh: 我不是想扫大家的兴，但要是下午起风了，山脊上可不好玩，我们最好中午前下来。
en: I don't want to be a killjoy, but if the wind picks up this afternoon, the ridge won't be much fun, so we'd be better off down by lunchtime.
point: “扫兴的人”killjoy；“起风”the wind picks up

zh: 等你真走完那条穿越线就明白了，为什么大家都说值，就算腿要疼好几天。
en: Once you've actually done the crossing, you'll see why everyone raves about it, even if your legs are wrecked for days afterwards.
point: once + 现在完成时；even if 后用现在时；“说值”rave about

zh: 你要是从没在冬天露过营，最好先在离家近的地方试一晚，万一太冷还能打道回府。
en: If you've never camped in winter, I'd give it a go somewhere close to home first, so you can bail if it gets too cold.
point: if + 现在完成时；“打道回府”口语 bail

zh: 说实话，除非他们换掉主教练，不然我看这个赛季基本就废了。
en: Honestly, unless they make a change at the top and bring in a new coach, I reckon this season's pretty much a write-off.
point: “基本废了”是 a write-off；unless 不和 otherwise 连用

zh: 你要是真想跑全马，最好先从半马练起，不然一下子跑太多，很容易受伤。
en: If you're serious about doing a full marathon, I'd work up to it with a half first, otherwise you're asking for an injury.
point: “循序渐进”work up to；“很容易受伤”asking for an injury

zh: 比赛还剩两分钟的时候，大家都以为输定了，谁知道他们在终场哨响前扳平了。
en: When there were two minutes to go, we'd all written them off, but they snatched a draw right on the final whistle.
point: “以为输定了”是 written them off；“还剩”to go

zh: 这部电影要是能有原著一半好看，我就谢天谢地了，不过我不抱什么希望。
en: If the movie's half as good as the book, I'll be pleasantly surprised, but I'm not holding my breath.
point: “不抱希望”是 not holding my breath；if 后用现在时

zh: 等你迷上钓鱼就知道了，周末早上五点起床根本不算什么。
en: Once you get hooked on fishing, you'll find getting up at five on a Saturday is no big deal.
point: “迷上”是 get hooked on；once 后用现在时

zh: 乐队十点多才上台，等他们演完，我们已经错过了末班车。
en: The band didn't come on until well after ten, and by the time they finished, we'd missed the last train home.
point: “…才上台”didn't come on until；by the time 配过去完成

zh: 那天你要是实在抽不开身就算了，不过能来的话，大家肯定都特别高兴。
en: No pressure if you can't get away that day, but if you can make it, I know everyone would love to see you.
point: “就算了”说 no pressure if；“抽不开身”can't get away

zh: 下次他再说要请客，我可不跟他客气了，上次他话一说完，账单一来就溜了。
en: Next time he offers to shout, I'm holding him to it, because last time he did a runner the minute the bill came.
point: “一…就…”用 the minute；请客 shout；溜了 did a runner

zh: 这样吧，你快到的时候给我发个信息，我出来接你，免得你在小区里绕晕了。
en: Tell you what, flick me a text when you're nearly here and I'll come out and meet you, in case you get lost in the complex.
point: “这样吧”是 tell you what；in case 后用现在时

zh: 我们本来不想大办，但要是双方父母都坚持，那也只能随他们了。
en: We weren't planning on anything big, but if both sets of parents dig their heels in, we'll probably just go along with it.
point: “坚持”dig their heels in；“随他们”go along with it

zh: 礼物的事你就别纠结了，等她拆开的那一刻，你就知道一切都值了。
en: Stop stressing about the present. The moment she unwraps it, you'll know it was worth all the hassle.
point: the moment 后用现在时 unwraps；“值了”worth the hassle

zh: 要不是你提醒我，我差点就把结婚纪念日忘了，那我可就没完没了了。
en: If you hadn't reminded me, I'd have completely forgotten our anniversary, and I'd never have heard the end of it.
point: “要不是”用 if you hadn't；“没完没了被念叨”never hear the end of it

zh: 等孩子们都长大离家了，你会怀念现在家里吵吵闹闹的日子的，信不信由你。
en: Once the kids have flown the nest, you'll miss all the noise and chaos, believe it or not.
point: “长大离家”是 fly the nest；once + 现在完成时

zh: 我婆婆每次来都要把厨房重新整理一遍，我也不好说什么，只能等她走了再放回去。
en: Every time my mother-in-law visits she reorganises the kitchen, and I don't like to say anything, so I just put it all back once she's gone.
point: “不好说什么”I don't like to say anything；once she's gone

zh: 你要是一直让他吃饭的时候看平板，以后再想让他改就难了。
en: If you keep letting him have the tablet at every meal, it's going to be an uphill battle getting him off it later.
point: “很难”说 an uphill battle；if + keep doing

zh: 那只猫只有饿了才会理你，其他时候根本不把你放在眼里。
en: That cat only gives you the time of day when she wants feeding. The rest of the time, you might as well not exist.
point: “只有…才理你”only … when；理睬 give you the time of day

zh: 你要是真打算养狗，先想清楚出国的时候谁来照顾它，再做决定。
en: If you're seriously thinking about getting a dog, have a think about who'll look after it when you go overseas before you commit.
point: if、when、before 三个从句；“下决定”commit

zh: 我们出门还不到五分钟，狗就把沙发垫撕得稀烂，真是一刻都不能离开它。
en: We weren't gone five minutes before the dog had ripped the sofa cushions to shreds. You can't turn your back on him for a second.
point: “还不到…就…”用 weren't gone … before；离开一下 turn your back

zh: 我知道你是好意，但等我准备好了自然会说，现在我只是需要一点空间。
en: I know you mean well, but I'll talk about it when I'm ready. Right now I just need a bit of space.
point: “你是好意”you mean well；when 后用现在时

zh: 直到自己当了妈妈，我才真正明白当年我妈有多不容易。
en: Only when I had kids of my own did I realise how hard Mum had it.
alt: It wasn't until I became a mum myself that I realised how tough my mum had it.
point: Only when … did I 倒装强调“直到…才”

zh: 你也别太自责了，换作是谁碰上这种事，都不一定能处理得比你好。
en: Don't be too hard on yourself. If anyone else had been in your shoes, they wouldn't necessarily have handled it any better.
point: “换作是谁”if anyone else had been in your shoes
